name: canonical-page-previews
goal: Classify framework compatibility redirects as nonvisual and capture actual report components by state

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Compatibility details routes canonicalize to existing entity pages and therefore have no own visual capture. They should be compact nonvisual entries. Report state captures must name only the components actually shown in that state.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: The category suite assumed every +page.svelte renders a distinct page. Add all seven built-in detail aliases plus a normal app details counterexample, and capture component-specific report states through the existing reports scenario.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Committed checkpoint 570f93b975da9675b83d97171bae76157d3a2241 fails compatibility routes are nonvisual for all seven built-in aliases; normal app details remain visual. Ready checks and component-state capture contracts are frozen.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Built-in details compatibility wrappers are compact service entries labelled Route alias; normal application detail pages remain visual. Report screenshot states explicitly cover only their visible components and isolate captured files before retention.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
